findings.title: Topic-meta link light and dark values are both inverted
findings.description: The `.topic-meta-data h5 a` rule used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The light branch is now 70%, which is roughly 2.1:1 contrast on white, so these links become hard to read on the default theme. The dark branch is `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)`, a dim gray on a dark background. The mirror of the original 30% is 70%, the same pairing `common/base/user.scss` uses for `.username a` (30/70). Restore 30% for light and use 70% for dark.

findings.title: Mobile topic heading light value changed from 20% to 50%
findings.description: The mobile `h3` changed from 20% to a light value of 50%. That is about 4:1 contrast on white, which is below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for normal-weight text. The dark branch is 50% where the mirror would be 80%. The desktop equivalent at `desktop/topic-post.scss:321` is 20/80. The mobile `h4` at line 190 is also 50/50, so `h3` and `h4` now share a color and lose their hierarchy. Restore 20% light and 80% dark.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message hint is inverted and inconsistent with desktop
findings.description: `.custom-message-length` changed from 70% to a light value of 30%, with dark at 70%. The desktop rule at `desktop/modal.scss:94` keeps the original 70/30 pairing, so the same hint renders darker on mobile than on desktop. The dark branch is also inverted, so the hint becomes bright gray on dark instead of dim. Restore 70% for light and 30% for dark to match desktop.

findings.title: Group member name loses its hierarchy and has the wrong dark value
findings.description: `.group-member-info .name` changed from 30% to a light value of 50%, with dark at 50%. The sibling `.title` in the same block is also 50/50 at line 527, so name and title are now the same color. The `.name` rule in `common/base/user.scss` uses 30/70 for the same kind of element. The mobile copy at `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497` has the identical change. Restore 30% light and 70% dark in both files.

findings.title: Hand-typed mirrored color pairs are already producing errors
Coldmap comment describes only the light default
findings.description: The comment says the topic-list table-cell default "is scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)". That is still the light value, but the default is now `dark-light-choose(...)` in `common/base/_topic-list.scss`, and the comment does not mention the dark branch. Update the comment to describe the light/dark pairing, or drop the specific value.
